summary: Build CMMC model, scoping, and assessment knowledge with PECB-authorized training. Prepare for the Certified CMMC Professional exam.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level CMMC course is designed for you if you support implementation, preparation, or assessment-related work. General cybersecurity and information technology knowledge is recommended, but the course page states no specific prerequisite for attending.
modules: CMMC Ecosystem, References, FCI, and CUI
CUI Protection and CMMC Model Domains
prerequisites: There is no specific prerequisite for participating in this training course. PECB recommends general knowledge of cybersecurity and information technology concepts and principles. Credential eligibility is separate from course entry: the credential table lists education or experience conditions, completion of the class through a Licensed Training Provider, and passing DoD CUI Awareness Training.
